title: fix(ui): keep chasing a spawned row until it actually lands
context:
After a spawn the client force-refreshed the session list at 0.6s, 1.5s and
3s, then stopped. For Codex that entire burst is spent before the engine has
written anything: measured, the rollout file appears at ~6.5s. So the row
waited for the next ordinary poll and the sidebar sat on "spawning" for
22s from submit -- roughly 15s of it dead time, with CCC already holding the
session id since 6.3s.

Keep nudging the list every 1.5s until the placeholder is reconciled, capped
at 45s. Stops immediate
